title: Experienced game artist + Claude code. Finished my first mobile solo game!
author: Guilo_art
selftext:
Got the UI myself, used asset packs for music and sprites and sounds. Code all by Claude and my first android game is finished. Pretty wild experience.

Feel free to test it [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.riftsurvivor&pcampaignid=web\_share](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.riftsurvivor&pcampaignid=web_share)

comments.author: Guilo_art
comments.body:
Hello yall! 

I'm a game artist with 8 years of experience, and for this game I basically used claude code to build the whole game code, architecture and help out with mechanics numbers and math.

UI was done and implemented by myself. I asked Claude a few times to make the slicing tho, since its a boring task sometimes.

This started out as a simple project because I was just in the "lets see if AI for gamedev is all of that people are talking about" and I noticed it actually IS and decided to build a experimental project with it
